highlights.title: See when an agent sits on one step
highlights.line: The hover on a Claude agent's card and its page say when it has been on one tool call for five minutes or more, and which tool.

highlights.title: Added agents keep their account and model
highlights.line: An agent you add from Found agents stays on the Claude account and model it was using, and Kosmos says if it could not tell.

highlights.title: The restart note says what was checked
highlights.line: After this computer restarts, the note says how many agents came back, names any that did not, and whether Kosmos's main records read fine.

highlights.title: A little more room between chat lines
highlights.line: Messages in an agent conversation on the computer now have a little more space between lines.

highlights.title: A warning before an agent runs twice
highlights.line: Adding an agent that another login job also starts now warns first and names that job.
